sources.title: Neuromorphic Sleep Stage Classification Using Time-Domain ISI Features ...
sources.snippet: This work presents a lightweight, biologically inspired software framework for five-stage sleep classification using single-channel EEG. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on frequency- domain transformations and deep architectures, this method operates entirely in the time domain.
